deadline.value: A PhD in Climate Sciences can be started at any time of the year once supervision and funding are arranged (central fall semester matriculation runs through October 15).
deadline.quote: A PhD can be started any time and takes 3 to 4 years full time work.

also.quote: You can apply to do a doctorate throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You need a PhD project at an affiliated research unit and a general agreement with the supervisor before applying.
supervisor.quote: must have a PhD project at one of the affiliated research units and a general agreement with the PhD supervisor

funding.value: The page gives no funding rule for admitted PhD students.

entry_route.value: A master's degree or equivalent is mandatory for the climate sciences PhD.
entry_route.quote: A Master of Science or an equivalent degree is mandatory for the admission to the PhD program

notes: The topic must be related to climate sciences. The school says registration and application fees apply but gives no amount.
name: PhD in Climate Sciences
